comments.author: @johndavidhobson8229
comments.text: If you know the history then you learn that it was US Americans who created this nonsense. It goes back to the partition of the Columbia District in 1846. The Washington Treaty of 1846 determined the border between the British colony of British Columbia was to be set at the 49th parallel. The survey of 1859 by British and USA surveyors mentioned the Point Roberts problem. The British suggested a solution with the point being a part of British Columbia with a similar territory being transferred to the USA. The USAmerican head surveyor refused the suggestion.
